title: AIPE Academy lesson metadata v0.2
description: One record of curriculum/catalogue.json. v0.2 adds the knowledge-architecture fields (module, covers), language mapping (concept, translation_status), reproducible labs (labs), the academic reference baseline (academic_references) and the standard lesson format marker (format). Every v0.1 field keeps its meaning; new fields other than module and concept are optional so existing records stay valid.

slug.description: Stable lesson id and URL segment: /academy/<domain>/<slug>/

track.description: A track id from curriculum/taxonomy.json belonging to the same domain

module.description: The knowledge module this lesson teaches (module id from curriculum/taxonomy.json). Null only for type 'stage' overviews that describe a whole track.

covers.description: Additional module ids this lesson teaches at introductory depth.

concept.description: Language-independent concept key. Records that share a concept are translations of the same knowledge unit and must differ in language.

translation_status.description: original: written in this language; reviewed-translation: translated and reviewed by a person; machine-translation: machine output not yet reviewed. Defaults to original.

format.description: aipe-lesson-v2 lessons must contain the thirteen standard sections of templates/lesson-template.md in order; the build checks this.

prerequisites.description: Lesson slugs; cross-domain references are allowed

references.description: Repository-relative reference files or https URLs

academic_references.description: Ids from references/mit-ocw-catalogue.json. The lesson's Academic References section must link each course's official URL.

labs.description: Repository-relative Python lab scripts this lesson uses
